description: This file implements the 'mod_access' plugin for the Lighttpd web server, handling access control via allow and deny rules through configuration and request handling functions.

methods.name: mod_access_init
methods.description: Initializes plugin data with zeroed memory.

methods.name: void mod_access_merge_config_cpv(plugin_config * const pconf,const config_plugin_value_t * const cpv)
methods.description: Merges specific configuration values into plugin config based on key ID.

methods.name: void mod_access_merge_config(plugin_config * const pconf,const config_plugin_value_t * cpv)
methods.description: Merges multiple configuration values into plugin config.

methods.name: void mod_access_patch_config(request_st * const r,const plugin_data * const p,plugin_config * const pconf)
methods.description: Creates a plugin configuration for a request by merging defaults with specific configs based on conditions.

methods.name: mod_access_set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration values for the plugin, initializes plugin data.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ handler_t mod_access_reject(request_st * const r,const plugin_config * const pconf)
methods.description: Handles URL access denial, logs the reason, and sets HTTP 403 status.

methods.name: __attribute_pure__ int mod_access_check(const array * const allow,const array * const deny,const buffer * const urlpath,const int lc)
methods.description: Checks whether the URL is allowed or denied based on allow and deny lists.

methods.name: mod_access_uri_handler
methods.description: Handles URI requests, checks access rules, and allows or denies access accordingly.

methods.name: int mod_access_plugin_init(plugin * p)
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, setting version, name, and callback functions.
